scripts.script:
-- EPIC FLY GUI
-- LocalScript | StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local speed = 60
local flying = false
local vertical = 0
local flyConnection
local bodyVelocity
local bodyGyro
local humanoid
local oldAutoRotate
local destroyed = false

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "EpicFlyGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- Main window
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "MainFrame"
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 255)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -127)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 27)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.ZIndex = 2
frame.Parent = gui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
mainCorner.Parent = frame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 58, 68)
stroke.Thickness = 1
stroke.Parent = frame

-- Black shadow, separate from the main window
local shadowHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
shadowHolder.Name = "ShadowHolder"
shadowHolder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
shadowHolder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 295)
shadowHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.5, -137)
shadowHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
shadowHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
shadowHolder.ZIndex = 0
shadowHolder.Parent = gui

local function makeShadowLayer(padding, transparency)
    local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
    layer.Size = UDim2.new(1, padding, 1, padding)
    layer.Position = UDim2.new(
        0, -padding / 2,
        0, -padding / 2 + 5
    )
    layer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    layer.BackgroundTransparency = transparency
    layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    layer.ZIndex = 0
    layer.Parent = shadowHolder

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16 + padding / 4)
    corner.Parent = layer
end

makeShadowLayer(38, 0.82)
makeShadowLayer(28, 0.65)
makeShadowLayer(18, 0.43)
makeShadowLayer(8, 0.22)

-- Shadow follows the frame's position and size
local function updateShadow()
    shadowHolder.Position = UDim2.new(
        frame.Position.X.Scale,
        frame.Position.X.Offset - 20,
        frame.Position.Y.Scale,
        frame.Position.Y.Offset - 20
    )

    shadowHolder.Size = UDim2.new(
        frame.Size.X.Scale,
        frame.Size.X.Offset + 40,
        frame.Size.Y.Scale,
        frame.Size.Y.Offset + 40
    )
end

updateShadow()

frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(updateShadow)
frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(updateShadow)

-- Title bar
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 33, 38)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.ZIndex = 3
titleBar.Parent = frame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

local titleCover = Instance.new("Frame")
titleCover.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
titleCover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -10)
titleCover.BackgroundColor3 = titleBar.BackgroundColor3
titleCover.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleCover.ZIndex = 3
titleCover.Parent = titleBar

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Epic Fly GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
title.TextSize = 16
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.ZIndex = 4
title.Parent = titleBar

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 28)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 6)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 39, 42)
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 190, 190)
closeButton.TextSize = 17
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.ZIndex = 4
closeButton.Parent = titleBar

Instance.new("UICorner", closeButton).CornerRadius =
    UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Smooth dragging; move the window and shadow together
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local activeDragInput
local dragTween
local shadowTween

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = frame.Position
        activeDragInput = input

        if dragTween then dragTween:Cancel() end
        if shadowTween then shadowTween:Cancel() end
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        local target = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )

        if dragTween then dragTween:Cancel() end

        dragTween = TweenService:Create(
            frame,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.06,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {Position = target}
        )
        dragTween:Play()
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == activeDragInput then
        dragging = false
        activeDragInput = nil
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        vertical = 0
    end
end)

-- Buttons
local function makeButton(name, text, size, position, color)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = color
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.ZIndex = 3
    button.Parent = frame

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    corner.Parent = button

    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            BackgroundColor3 = color:Lerp(
                Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.08
            )
        }):Play()
    end)

    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {
            BackgroundColor3 = color
        }):Play()
    end)

    return button
end

local flyButton = makeButton(
    "FlyButton", "Fly",
    UDim2.fromOffset(166, 36),
    UDim2.fromOffset(13, 51),
    Color3.fromRGB(48, 135, 91)
)

local stopButton = makeButton(
    "StopButton", "Stop",
    UDim2.fromOffset(166, 36),
    UDim2.fromOffset(13, 95),
    Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 65)
)

-- Speed input
local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(166, 18)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 140)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "FLIGHT SPEED"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 168, 180)
speedLabel.TextSize = 11
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speedLabel.ZIndex = 3
speedLabel.Parent = frame

local speedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
speedBox.Name = "SpeedBox"
speedBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(166, 34)
speedBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 161)
speedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 38, 44)
speedBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
speedBox.Text = "60"
speedBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter speed"
speedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
speedBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(135, 138, 150)
speedBox.TextSize = 14
speedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
speedBox.ZIndex = 3
speedBox.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", speedBox).CornerRadius =
    UDim.new(0, 6)

local speedStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
speedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 62, 72)
speedStroke.Thickness = 1
speedStroke.Parent = speedBox

local function updateSpeed()
    local value = tonumber(speedBox.Text)

    if value then
        speed = math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, 500)
    end

    speedBox.Text = tostring(speed)
end

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(updateSpeed)

-- Up / Down buttons
local upButton = makeButton(
    "UpButton", "▲\nUP",
    UDim2.fromOffset(82, 54),
    UDim2.fromOffset(199, 65),
    Color3.fromRGB(65, 95, 145)
)

local downButton = makeButton(
    "DownButton", "▼\nDOWN",
    UDim2.fromOffset(82, 54),
    UDim2.fromOffset(199, 130),
    Color3.fromRGB(95, 75, 130)
)

-- Flight cleanup
local function stopFlying()
    flying = false
    vertical = 0

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if bodyVelocity then
        bodyVelocity:Destroy()
        bodyVelocity = nil
    end

    if bodyGyro then
        bodyGyro:Destroy()
        bodyGyro = nil
    end

    if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
        humanoid.AutoRotate =
            oldAutoRotate == nil and true or oldAutoRotate

        if humanoid.Health > 0 then
            humanoid:ChangeState(
                Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp
            )
        end
    end
end

-- Start flying
local function startFlying()
    if flying or destroyed then return end

    updateSpeed()

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
    flying = true
    vertical = 0

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "EpicFlyVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyVelocity.P = 15000
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = root

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "EpicFlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    bodyGyro.P = 12000
    bodyGyro.D = 800
    bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = root

    humanoid.AutoRotate = false
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not root.Parent
            or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            stopFlying()
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        local move = Vector3.zero
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            move += look
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            move -= look
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            move += right
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            move -= right
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            move += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            move -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        move += Vector3.new(0, vertical, 0)

        if move.Magnitude > 1 then
            move = move.Unit
        end

        bodyVelocity.Velocity = move * speed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)
end

-- Hold Up / Down to move vertically
upButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        vertical = 1
    end
end)

downButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        vertical = -1
    end
end)

flyButton.Activated:Connect(startFlying)
stopButton.Activated:Connect(stopFlying)

-- Close button stops flight and destroys GUI
closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if destroyed then return end
    destroyed = true

    stopFlying()

    if dragTween then
        dragTween:Cancel()
    end

    gui:Destroy()
end)

-- Clean up on respawn
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    stopFlying()
end)

Universal Hub Lite V2 is a universal Roblox utility platform built to be more than just a command bar.

It keeps the fast command-driven workflow people expect from scripts like Infinite Yield, but builds a much broader system around it. Instead of treating every feature as an isolated command, Lite V2 connects its tools, interface, AI, integrations, saved state, and external systems through one unified runtime.

What makes Lite V2 different?

The command bar is only one way to interact with Universal Hub.

Features can be accessed through the interface, contextual actions, AI, external tools, integrations, and other supported systems. As Lite V2 continues to grow, the goal is to make Universal Hub something that can be interacted with from multiple places rather than locking everything behind a single command line.

The built-in AI is also designed to work with the hub itself rather than simply act as a chatbot. It can access supported Universal Hub capabilities, retrieve live information, interact with tools, and perform supported actions through the same underlying system used by the rest of the hub.

Lite V2 also supports external integrations and is being built with broader connector and tooling support in mind, allowing compatible services and applications to interact with Universal Hub in ways traditional universal scripts generally are not designed around.

Compared to Infinite Yield

Infinite Yield is primarily a lightweight and mature universal command utility.

Lite V2 takes a different approach.

It keeps the speed and convenience of a command-based utility while expanding the idea into a larger universal platform built around connected tools, integrations, automation, AI, customization, and multiple ways of interacting with the same functionality.

Some of what Lite V2 offers:

• Large universal utility and command library
• Smart command discovery and autocomplete
• Advanced player and movement tools
• Player targeting and contextual actions
• Script discovery and management
• Player and server information tools
• AI integration with access to hub capabilities
• External tool and integration support
• Communication and translation tools
• Media and service integrations
• Workspace and utility tools
• Server and session management
• Persistent configuration and preferences
• Customizable interface and accessibility options
• Interactive notifications and actions
• Desktop and mobile support
• A growing ecosystem of connectors and integrations

Lite V2 is designed to feel less like a collection of unrelated commands and more like one connected environment that can continue expanding without changing how the rest of the hub works.

Compatibility Note

Universal Hub Lite V2 makes use of a wide range of executor capabilities, so support can vary depending on the executor being used.

Lower-level or less capable executors may have reduced functionality, missing features, visual issues, or may not be supported at all. Some parts of the hub rely on executor-specific capabilities such as filesystem access, custom assets, HTTP requests, environment functions, teleport persistence, and other advanced APIs.

Xeno is currently unsupported.

For the best experience, use a modern executor with strong Luau and executor API support.

Universal Hub Lite V2 is built around one idea: one universal platform, multiple ways to interact with it.

Visit universalhub.cc for additional features, integrations, updates, and more information.

local function GetCameraRelativeDirection()
    local dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir = dir + camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local moveDir = player.Character.Humanoid.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Magnitude == 0 then

            local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector
            local forwardAmt = moveDir:Dot(camera.CFrame.LookVector.Unit)
            local rightAmt = moveDir:Dot(camera.CFrame.RightVector.Unit)
            dir = (look * forwardAmt) + (right * rightAmt)
        end
    end
    return dir
end
